header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: only for that (Hereafter) Day. (On that Day) they will be hastening forward with their heads raised (looking upward); their (fixed) gaze will not return to them, and their hearts will be void (with terror).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذِنِ الْحَقُّ ۚ فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ۞ وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا بِآيتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ ).
blocks.tamil_translation: The weighing (of everyone's deeds) on that Day will be true; then those whose (good) scales are heavy — it is they who are the successful. And those whose scales (of good) are light (lacking in weight), they are the ones who have brought loss upon themselves because they kept rejecting Our verses.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (جَنّتُ عَدْنٍ يَّدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّلُؤْلُؤاً ۚ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ ۞ وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ؕ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ ۞ اَلَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ ۚ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَّلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (For them there are) everlasting Gardens — they will enter them; therein they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and (ornaments of) pearls; and their garments therein will be silk.”All praise belongs to Allah, Who has removed grief from us!
